title: STATISTICS ＆ SIMULATION
description: Probability and simulation. Statistics building on knowledge in probability and simulation. Point and interval estimation, hypothesis testing, and regression. A specialized version of IEOR E4150 for MSE and MSBA students who are exempt from the first half of IEOR E4101 . Must obtain waiver for E4101
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Understanding of single- and multivariable calculus.
